resources.name: Porous BCZT piezoelectric and dielectric properties

access.notes: Table 1 and Figure 4 of Zhang et al. (2019) provide d31, d33 and relative permittivity at each porosity (0–25%).

resources.notes: Data for 0,5,10,15,20,25% porosity used in harvester simulation.

resources.name: Cantilever beam and patch geometry and steel material

access.notes: Geometry: steel beam 300×10×5 mm, BCZT patch 150×10×5 mm, proof mass 15 mg; standard steel Young's modulus and density. Dimensions and materials are given in the paper.

resources.notes: Geometry and host material values fixed for all simulations.
